text: Steenbarger: the room stands behind no single trigger, and none answers my test. in_zone:ma_20 has no volume term; livermore's h1_close_above:bar_high and seow's trade_above:bar_high sit nearest my buy point (W close_vs_swing_high_pct 1.04, inside 5% of the pivot, C17); wyckoff's reclaim:vwap_14d is another entry.
